# Ai_WriteDistance8AngleSentinel — 0x5421D0

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.py. -->

Original x86 stores two coordinate pairs, computes signed squared-distance/sqrt, and conditionally writes double 10000.0 to context+0x50 after an 8.0 gate. Ordinary finite threshold interpretation only; overflow and gameplay VERIFY.

- 種別　`func`
- 対象　迫真戦記 ver0.67
